historical_references.context: Ghumair ibn Manzur was a Berber military leader who rebelled against the Marinids, the ruling dynasty of Morocco, in 1331 CE. He managed to gain the support of several powerful Berber tribes, and was able to capture the city of Fes before being defeated and killed in battle.
